source.detail: digitized: Mosadegh et al. 2014 SI Fig S5 (tip trajectory, FEM series) + Fig S6 (blocked force, Sensor series)

metadata.notes: Pneu-net (pneumatic network) bending finger; Ecoflex 30 extensible layer / Sylgard 184 PDMS inextensible strain limiter. Tier-1 curves only (free tip trajectory + blocked force output vs pressure); no shape/Gramian block -- see data_completeness. Bending device: polarity_axial is not meaningful (not an axial contract/extend actuator) and is left null rather than forced to a value. free.tip_displacement_m uses the FEM trajectory series (SI Fig S5 panel F) because the Camera (experimental) series has only 2 digitizable points (marker occlusion per PROVENANCE.md 'Dropped points') -- below the tier-1 minimum of 3. FEM is the paper's own finite-element prediction, not an independent measurement.

input.energy_convention: mechanical work delivered at the input port (J)

blocked.method: digitized SI Fig S6 force-sensor curve; source paper does not state the force-gauge axis explicitly -- recorded as transverse (bending/blocking) force, not axial, consistent with a bending pneu-net finger

provenance.citation: Mosadegh, B. et al. "Pneumatic Networks for Soft Robotics that Actuate Rapidly." Adv. Funct. Mater. 24(15), 2163-2170, 2014. doi:10.1002/adfm.201303288
